failureReason: The model created middleware.ts instead of proxy.ts. All 4 runs fail the same test: "proxy.ts file exists in root (Next.js 16+ convention)". The model received a deprecation warning during build ("middleware file convention is deprecated, please use proxy instead") but did not iterate to fix the issue. The code logic is correct (4/5 tests pass), but the file was created with the wrong name, using the deprecated convention.
